title: keiwooo-crosshair-health
body:
## Health Color Crosshair

This Fabric client-side mod changes the crosshair color depending on the health of the targeted entity.

### Features
- Crosshair color dynamically updates based on target health
- Smooth color transitions
- Works only when aiming at an entity
- Fully client-side (safe for servers)

### Color Logic
- Green: High health
- Yellow: Medium health
- Red: Low health

### Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API required

### Notes
This mod does NOT provide unfair gameplay advantages.
It only visualizes existing in-game information.
If the mod is well-received, I'll share the requested versions. If you like it, join this Discord server and let me know what you think. https://discord.gg/pnfed4Shdh
